observations.why: Directive with operational cadence language ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects others to follow.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic identity-level statement framed as constitutive bedrock — an unrehearsed rollback equals no rollback at all — delivered as creed, not argument.
Record-keeping entry ratifying the cadence as a settled operational fact; performed declarative recording the decision.
Assigning ownership ratifies the decision's operational structure — a performed declarative recording who is accountable.
